subject: Kickoff: Joint Close Playbook & Eval Runway
messages:
From: Ellie Harper <eharper@talus.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Andrew Cho <andrew.cho@paxio.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: Joint Close Playbook & Eval Runway

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team liked the latency numbers and the ability to pin model variants per route. We'd like to move from discussion to a concrete 30-day evaluation, but before we lock dates we want to align on a lightweight close playbook that covers stakeholders, success criteria, and the basic tech acceptance gates.

Can you share a starter MAP + a one-slide playbook that we can circulate internally? Our procurement and security teams will want to see the timeline and a short list of required deliverables.

High-level asks from our side:
- A short milestone cadence (weekly check-ins + 30-day acceptance)
- Owner assignments for infra & SRE questions
- Acceptance tests (throughput, p95 latency, sample prompt pass rate)

Andrew (copied) will coordinate schedules on our end.

Appreciate a draft today or tomorrow if possible — we have an internal review on Friday.

Cheers,
Ellie Harper
Director, Product Partnerships
Talus AI

Attachment: none — prefer Google Doc link
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Ellie Harper <eharper@talus.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-12T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Joint Close Playbook & Eval Runway

Thanks Ellie — great to see momentum. I've drafted a starter MAP and a one-slide playbook with the items you listed. Links and attachments below.

Summary of what I shared:
- MAP doc (starter sections: objectives, stakeholders, milestones, risk & mitigations, acceptance criteria)
- Playbook slide deck (one-slide executive summary + 3 operational slides)
- Pilot acceptance checklist (baselines for throughput, p95 latency, and sample prompt QA)

Please review the MAP and populate the Talus owners in the stakeholders section. Suggested week0 -> week4 cadence is in the doc; happy to compress if you need faster turnaround.

Drive links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-redwood-MAP-template (redwood-MAP-template.gdoc)
Slides: attached (close-playbook-slides-v1.pptx)
Checklist: attached (pilot-acceptance-checklist.xlsx)

Next steps:
- Ellie / Andrew: confirm stakeholder roster + preferred week0 start date
- Monica: lead the kickoff + tech FAQ on day 1
- Ben: review the acceptance checklist and reply with any ask for sample datasets

If helpful I can run a 30-min workshop tomorrow to walk the MAP and expected data handoffs.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai

Adding a couple technical notes to the MAP draft (see inline comments on the doc):

- We'll need a short data access diagram (SRE wants to know what stays in Talus VPC and what touches Redwood Dedicated).
- For the throughput acceptance, please include the test harness specs (sample payload size, concurrency pattern). I've attached a small template for that to the Drive doc.
- If Talus plans to use private deployment (VPC/on-prem), there are a couple of extra steps in week0 for firewall rules and KMS onboarding — I added a week0 checklist item.

Aditya / Monica: I can join the kickoff and own the day-1 perf run.

On Tue, May 12, 2026 at 9:12 AM Ellie Harper <eharper@talus.ai> wrote:
> Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team liked the latency numbers and the ability to pin model variants per route.

Thanks, all — the MAP doc is very helpful and the timeline looks achievable. Two quick updates from Talus:

1) Stakeholder roster: I've added Talus owners inline (Emily Park for procurement, Samir Rao for security, Daniel Ortiz for SRE).
2) Preferred start: target week0 kickoff the week of May 24 (gives procurement a week to review).

We reviewed the acceptance checklist and have two asks:
- Can the perf run include a mixed prompt mix (short + long + multi-turn) so our product QA can validate degraded outputs?
- Acceptable p95 latency target: <= 250ms on the sample workload you provided.

Andrew will coordinate procurement items (PO and initial security questionnaire). Can we lock a 30-min kickoff on Monday May 24 at 10am PT? If that works, Monica / Ben / Aditya can you confirm?

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Ellie
Director, Product Partnerships | Talus AI
